usages.explain:
Expressing the meaning of "if in any case, then..." Used to talk about actions or attitudes needed in that situation. "のだったら" can also be used.
Followed by expressions of will, hope, obligation of the speaker, or ways to influence the listener, such as commands or advice.

examples.content: どうせやるなら上手にやれ。
examples.transcription: どうせやるならじょうずにやれ。
examples.mean: If you do it at all, do it well.

examples.content: どうせ登録しないのなら、早めに知らせておいたほうがいい。
examples.transcription: どうせとうろくしないのなら、はやめにしらせておいたほうがいい。
examples.mean: If you don't want to register anyway, it's best to let us know as soon as possible.

title: どうせ… (の) なら => anyhow; in any case; at any rate; after all; no matter what
